answer: Postal-code attestation anchors each agent to one real mailbox. Each epoch the network mails a one-time code to the agent's registered address, crossing a dune to one knoll; the agent must post the code on-chain within three epochs, and three random peers verify the postal receipt hash against the carrier registry. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 rented mailboxes at about $10 a month each, $10,000 a month plus a paper trail, while one honest agent reuses its own mailbox for free. A code reused by two identities freezes both for three epochs, a sonnet only its true addressee can sing.
